messages:
emma (AE): Quick ask — Acme (POC) wants explicit IR / breach notify timelines and whether we can promise 24h for PII exposures. Also asked for CAIQ + short list of controls they can present to their legal team. Can someone sketch the standard position I should share?

sanjay (Security): TL;DR — hosted-default: we acknowledge incidents within 4h, provide an initial customer notification within 72h for confirmed exfiltration of customer data. Dedicated/Private: we can negotiate tighter notification SLAs (24h) in the contract + add specific reporting contacts. Regulatory obligations (GDPR/state laws) may require faster or different handling.

ellen (SRE): For operational context: our incident lifecycle is detection -> triage (T+0–2h) -> containment (T+2–8h for sev1) -> root-cause / remediation updates every 4–8h. We can produce a condensed timeline snapshot for POC decks.

raj (Solutions Eng): I have a short POC handoff note I use — will paste below. It spells out roles, expected timelines, and a sample notify email. Use/adapt: 

```
POC Incident Handoff (example):
- Point of Contact: acme-ciso@acme.com; Redwood SOC (soc@redwood.com)
- Initial ack: within 4 hours
- Customer notification (confirmed exposure): hosted = within 72 hours; dedicated/private = contractual (can be 24h)
- Ongoing updates: every 8 hours until containment
- Post-incident report: delivered within 5 business days
```

raj (Solutions Eng): Sample breach notification (short):

```
Subject: Security Incident Notification — [Redwood] — [brief desc]
Hi <Customer>,
We are contacting you to notify of a security incident affecting <scope>. Initial detection: <date/time>. Immediate containment steps taken: <list>. We are continuing an investigation and will provide an updated technical summary within 24/72 hours depending on severity. If you need an expedited channel, please confirm the primary contact.

Regards,
Redwood Security
```

sanjay (Security): For CAIQ/SIG: we routinely provide the completed SIG profile and the CAIQ export for enterprise reviewers. For POCs we also include a 1-page mapping showing where key controls are implemented (auth, encryption at rest/in-transit, RBAC, audit logging, key management, KMS integrations, data retention). If legal needs attestations, we can add contractual language for Dedicated/Private.

emma (AE): Helpful — can you list the specific control names I should call out (one-liners) so legal can skim quickly?

sanjay (Security): Sure — short list you can paste:
- Data encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS1.3 in transit
- Access control: SSO (SAML/OIDC), RBAC + short-lived tokens
- Key management: customer-managed KMS supported in Private/Dedicated
- Logging & monitoring: centralized audit logs retained 90 days (app + admin)
- Vulnerability program: monthly scanning + quarterly pen tests
- Incident response: SOC triage 24/7, ack <=4h, customer notif <=72h (contractual exceptions)

ellen (SRE): One more ops note — for POC customers we can offer a lightweight runbook (non-privileged) that shows how we will communicate (channels, cadence) and what evidence we can share (sanitized logs, timeline). That tends to calm legal.

emma (AE): Perfect. Raj — can you drop the CAIQ link + the 1-pager into the POC pack and I'll send to Acme. Sanjay/ellen — do we need to escalate this to the account SDR/AM for contract language if they push 24h?

raj (Solutions Eng): Will add CAIQ + 1-pager to the pack in the next 45 min.

sanjay (Security): If they insist on 24h we need Sales + Legal looped for Dedicated/Private; for Hosted we can offer procedural commitments (faster notifications) but not guaranteed SLA unless contractually agreed. Please @legal if it becomes a must-have.

deploy-bot: Incident stub created: INC-2026-452 — severity pending — assigned to sec-oncall.

emma (AE): Thanks all — I'll hold on sending anything until the pack is updated. If Acme insists on 24h for hosted, I'll ask for a risk-accepted clause and escalate to legal.

ellen (SRE): FYI — if they request forensic artifacts, we can provide sanitized packet summaries and logs, but full raw logs require NDA + data access agreement. Mention that up-front.

emma (AE): Noted. Closing loop after Raj uploads the docs. :thumbsup:
